excluded: All database dumps, plaintext and ciphertext, including .dump.age
AGE private identities, SSH keys, OAuth/config caches, .env and real credential values
Raw stdout/stderr/logs, provider response bodies, rendered/declared variable maps
Student/account records, cookies, handshakes and authenticated browser material
All real operational intents and non-fixture receipts; including rehearsal/durable-store/transfer actual receipts
No recursive .cache archive and no node_modules/native binaries/Docker images
Old phase2 r1 and old failed operators except three source fixtures read by new-reader tests

privacyReview.syntheticCredentialLikeLiterals: Three inert/fixture PostgreSQL URLs; test-only marker strings. No real DSN or secret.
privacyReview.historicalFixtureReview: Recursive JSON key/type and string-pattern review: identity/deployment/hash/command/version/count metadata and boolean proofs only; no URL query, raw headers, credential value, database name/user, student record or key path.
privacyReview.limits: Static source/fixture review is scoped to the exact allowlist. Public provider IDs, resource names, source hashes and fixed operator paths remain visible. Synthetic age test creates a fresh temporary test identity outside Git; no identity bytes are archived.

portabilityLimits: This is restoration of exact source bytes into the original cache layout in a compatible checkout, not an arbitrary-machine executable bundle.
Restore exclusively or skip only byte-identical existing files; reject path escape, symlink and divergent existing destination.
Never normalize source newlines, edit pins, refresh historic dates or execute snapshots from docs.
Pinned external CLI/native tools and repository product module remain separate requirements.

Helper mains for staging/rehearsal/durable-store are included only because the final operator imports their functions; their historical operation receipts/configs are not needed and their commands must not be replayed.
Current/future five VERIFY receipts, final manifest and final backup/transfer evidence are dynamic operation inputs, not fabricated fixtures.
Before using any operational command collect fresh real proofs and follow existing permanent intents/no-replay guards. This archive is not an authorization or readiness proof.
snapshotCopyPlan: Read each exact allowlisted original as Buffer and check manifest SHA/bytes before writing.
Write snapshots as original bytes; preserve subdirectories for receipt.json; no recursive directory copy.
Add local .gitattributes snapshots/** -text; validate checkout snapshot SHA and Git index blob SHA before commit.
README lists restoration only, explicit current entrypoints and separate inert test commands; metadata manifest binds every snapshot to original/restore paths.
Do not execute or import any operator during archive creation.

dockerExclusion.evidence: Existing /docs and /.cache patterns. No Dockerfile edits or builds needed.

fixedReadScope.included: All .cache imports/SOURCES and fixed reads invoked by the current maintenance/fresh-reader/final-backup/final-transfer entrypoints, plus the included test fixtures.
notInvokedHistoricalMains: staging-members-image-reload-r1.mjs main: old staging baseline/canonical source/proposal files are not read by declaredValue/projectServices helpers used here.
staging-reconcile-cron-activate-r2.mjs and staging-reconcile-bff-proof-r3.mjs mains: old BFF receipts/cron intents/bundle are not read by final transfer helpers.
production-backup-rehearsal-r2-transfer-r2.mjs main: actual rehearsal receipt/ciphertext excluded; final transfer only calls pinned utility exports.
production-backup-durable-store-r2.mjs main: actual store/recovery receipts and key files excluded.
fixedReadScope.currentDynamicInputsExcluded: Real fresh plans/check/apply/HTTP/VERIFY receipts; final five-reference manifest; final restore receipt; ciphertext; AGE recovered identity; live provider OAuth/SSH identity. These remain separate reviewed operation inputs, never fabricated fixtures.
